Inna Valkova and Larisa Valkova are the mother and grandmother of well-known Chess commentator, streamer and presenter Angelika Valkova. Both of them are deeply connected with chess - even in their age, they travel across the world and cover chess tournaments - take photos, make reels, and a lot more! Check out this interview with this special duo.
Video: ChessBase India
Interview: Abhyudaya Ram
Edited by: Himank Ghosh
